name: Cometary-Vortex
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near ancient meteor crater.
Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Instruments disagree about gravity well anomaly: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
